title: Same-Day Renewal Credit on Certificate Installation
content:
**Billing desk Q&A: the same-day renewal credit on managed installations of SSL/TLS Certificates**

**What is the renewal bundle credit?**
It is a fixed credit against the managed installation charge of an SSL/TLS Certificates subscription. It applies when the managed installation is booked on a day on which a renewal of that same subscription was billed. Only renewal lines in the subscription's certificate billing history dated the same day as the installation count.

**How much is it?**

| Renewal lines of the subscription billed on the installation day | Renewal bundle credit |
|---|---|
| at least one line of charge type renewal, whether or not a line of charge type auto-renew was also billed that day | USD 2.50 |
| only lines of charge type auto-renew | USD 1.50 |
| no renewal line of either type | no renewal bundle credit |

**Does a renewal billed the day before count?**
No. The renewal line must carry the same date as the installation. A renewal billed on any earlier day leaves the installation without this credit.

**Can both amounts apply together?**
No. A day with a renewal-type line takes USD 2.50 once, even if an auto-renew line was also billed that day. The two amounts are never added together.

**Hypothetical cases** (invented histories, installation booked on 9 September 2033):

- A renewal line dated 9 September 2033: credit USD 2.50.
- An auto-renew line dated 9 September 2033 and no renewal-type line: credit USD 1.50.
- An auto-renew line and a renewal line, both dated 9 September 2033: credit USD 2.50.
- A renewal line dated 8 September 2033 only: no renewal bundle credit.
